podcast.title: Dominant British Independent Label
podcast.body: Cooking Vinyl is identified as one of the independent labels that dominate much of the British rock scene today. "much of the British rock scene is dominated by independent labels like Domino and Cooking Vinyl and Go Disks, Rough Trade, XL Recording and dozens and dozens more."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: The Orb's New Album Release
podcast.body: Cooking Vinyl, referred to in the transcript as "Cookie and Bindle," is the label releasing The Orb's album "No Sounds Are Out of Bounds" on June 22nd. "editado por Cookie and Bindle."
